podcast.body: This album was released on October 20, 2023, after recording sessions began in January 2022. Travis Barker self-produced the album in his home studio. It was profoundly influenced by Mark Hoppus's battle with cancer, the band's rekindled relationships, and a sense of maturity. The recording was kept secret to ensure the reconciliation with Tom DeLonge would work. It includes 17 tracks, plus 10 bonus tracks, and a "cancer song" titled "You Don't Know What You've Got." The album debuted at number one on the Billboard Top 200, aided by 11 different vinyl versions, and charted highly internationally. "One more time is an interesting album for Blink 182 because it was obviously affected by Mark's cancer, relationships, friendships, and becoming a little more mature."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
